problem: Create one governed client model for onboarding, custody accounts, portfolios, holdings, settlement instructions, and cash movements without starting from a blank ontology.
primary_question: Can Northstar trace an approved client through its custody account and portfolio to a holding, settlement instruction, and completed cash movement?
source_ontology: FIBO with supporting OMG Commons concepts

source_selections.reason: Provides the financial account meaning, provider, holder, balance, identifier, and lifecycle context needed by a custody account.
Provides the monetary amount and obligation semantics needed by a custody cash movement.
Provides a stable general party concept for clients, owners, managers, and service providers.
Provides the controlled currency concept used for account reporting, valuation, and settlement.
Provides the governed investment instrument represented by a custody holding.

acceptance_criteria: Exact selected source URIs are present and source provenance is retained.
Every target class has a label, definition, and unique URI.
Identifiers, dates, quantity, statuses, and relationship cardinalities appear in generated application schemas.
The client-to-account-to-settlement-to-cash-movement path is testable with instance data.
No ontology schema nodes or ontology-only relationships are loaded into the dataset database.
The finalized release can be rebuilt from canonical RDF and versioned artifacts.
